BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald O'Donovan are delighted to present No. 7 Rose Lane to the market, a beautifully finished three-bedroom mid-terrace home, in a superb location just minutes from Midleton.

Presented in turnkey condition, this is a home that is sure to impress. Offering generous living accommodation, tasteful décor throughout, a private rear garden that is not overlooked, and the added benefit of rear access, the property has been extensively renovated in recent years and is finished to an exceptionally high standard.

Extending to approximately 85 sqm (915 sqft), accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, guest W/C, spacious kitchen/dining room, and a bright living room with an open fireplace on the ground floor. Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a main bedroom with an en-suite shower room, together with a modern family bathroom.

Located in the sought-after village of Ballinacurra, the property enjoys the best of both worlds, a peaceful residential setting within walking distance of Midleton and excellent access to the N25, making Cork City easily accessible.

This is an ideal home for first-time buyers, families, or those looking to downsize without compromising on quality or convenience.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
